name: Transaction / Budget Detail
route: No live route; transaction and budget detail are nested Money Map stack modes.
annotation: Transaction / Budget Detail hero (ProgressRing + spend/allocated read) is the singular focal moment, not one tile among many; TopBar stays plain except for edit. Operational layer stacks Budget hero -> CIAInsightCard -> Recent activity history, all quiet and source-specific beneath the hero. A single BtnPrimary ('Edit budget') is the persistent CTA; recategorize, replace-receipt, and delete stay ghost pills or row actions. ContextToggle switches the same shell between Budget View and Transaction View since both are nested Money Map stack modes, not separate routes.

modules.build: System standard, transparent over dark shell atmosphere (warm amber radial glow, top-center).

Transparent over atmosphere; gains glass-pill (rgba(10,10,15,.55), blur 24px, border rgba(255,255,255,.10), r999) once content scrolls under. BtnGhost [chevron-left] 44px target 'Back' | Title 'Dining budget' | BtnGhost [pencil] 'Edit', 44px target.

NEW: compact segmented pill, glass, 44px targets: 'Budget' (active, orange underline) and 'Transaction'. Switches this one shell between Budget View and Transaction View without duplicating screens, per spec rationale.

SolidCard #211008 r40 hero, glow-you. Overline 'Allocated this month'. ProgressRing 78% (H1 30 paper-100). Body '$480 spent / $620 allocated', ChipProvenance 'via Plaid'. Caption '12 days left · on pace'. ProgressBar (capped) fill beneath, with pace marker.

GlassCard r28 purple-tinted, glow-cia. Body 15 paper-100: 'Dining jumps 40% after short sleep.' (Newsreader Medium Italic on 'sleep'). ChipProvenance 'calculated · spend pattern'. ChipDomainTag 'Finance' + 'Wellbeing', 16% bg, tappable -> dashboards. BtnGhost 'Ask CIA ->' — this card is the chat exit.

Overline 'Recent activity'. SolidCard #211008 (dense list, no glow). ListRow 'Joe's Pizza · 2 days ago · -$24.00', ChipProvenance 'via Plaid'. ListRow 'Spotify · 4 days ago · -$11.99', ChipProvenance 'via Plaid'.
BtnPrimary (only primary CTA on-screen), full-width, orange #FF5E00, glow-you: 'Edit budget'. Opens budget-edit Sheet, spring-in with focus trap and drag-to-dismiss.
Floating pill, fixed overlay: Today · CIA · Goals · Me, 44px targets, overlays last visible content per canon.

belowFold: Transaction View mode (ContextToggle -> 'Transaction'): SolidCard r40 hero replaces the Budget hero. Signed amount '-$42.10' (H1 30, real state) + ChipProvenance 'via Plaid' or 'you logged'; low-confidence pending values render muted; honest-null hides the hero entirely until an amount exists. Label 'Expense' · merchant 'Trader Joe's'. Metadata rows: category 'Groceries' (ListRow, opens category-picker Sheet) and 'Receipt attached' (ListRow, opens receipt-options Sheet) — honest-null reads 'No receipt attached.' Amount scales 0.96 to 1.0 on entry while metadata rows rise.

Row actions (Transaction View): BtnSecondary 'Recategorize', BtnGhost 'Replace receipt', BtnGhost 'Delete' — Delete is hidden (not shown-then-denied) per the Disabled state while a transaction is still pending bank clearance.
Sheets (per Components list): delete-confirmation, category-picker, budget-edit, and receipt-options — all spring in with focus trap and drag-to-dismiss, matching Motion spec.
trustControls: Transaction amount: real = signed value + ChipProvenance 'via Plaid' or 'you logged'; low-confidence pending values render muted; honest-null hides the hero entirely until an amount exists.
Budget spent/allocated: real = '$480 spent / $620 allocated'; low-confidence = 'estimated - low confidence'; honest-null = 'No spending in Dining yet. Budget fully available.'
Days remaining: real uses finance-cycle data; low-confidence marks the value approximate; honest-null = 'Cycle dates unknown.'
Category list rows: real transactions carry merchant, amount, and source; low-confidence rows read 'merchant pending'; honest-null = 'No transactions in this budget yet.'
CIA suggestion amount: real uses a 3-month average with a calculated-source label; low-confidence is labeled; honest-null = '2 of 3 merchants synced - check back soon.'
Receipt: real shows attachment metadata; honest-null = 'No receipt attached.'

Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete wherever money or billing data appears; documented as a nested Money Map stack mode, never an invented live route.
Disabled: Delete hidden while a transaction is pending bank clearance. Offline: editing and deletion disabled unless a local queue exists; data reads stale with a timestamp.
notes: No GLM draft was available to correct: the worker call failed twice with HTTP 529 (service overloaded), so this packet was authored directly from the spec and canon digest rather than as a fix pass. Key decisions: (1) italicWord is 'sleep', not the Visual System section's generic '*detail*' placeholder — that line is boilerplate template text repeated near-verbatim across many hifi specs (compare 14-goal-detail.md, which also names '*detail*' in Visual System yet the built packet correctly used '*momentum*' because that word is embedded directly in the Final Composition wireframe's CIA copy); here the wireframe embeds '*sleep*' inside 'Dining jumps 40% after short *sleep*.', so that word wins. (2) Budget Hero uses SolidCard r40 rather than GlassCard: canon reserves glass for focal surfaces, but the Components list explicitly classifies 'budget overview' under SolidCard's dense-surface bucket, and Mission Detail [14] sets the same precedent (its focal ProgressRing hero is SolidCard, not glass) — glass is reserved here for CIAInsightCard, Sheets, and GlassNavBar only. (3) hasNav is true because this screen has a single parent stack (Money Map [30]), matching Mission Detail [14]'s single-parent pattern, not the multi-entry-point drill-down pattern of Streak Details [59] (hasNav false). (4) Only one BtnPrimary renders on-screen ('Edit budget'); Transaction View's Recategorize/Replace receipt/Delete are BtnSecondary/BtnGhost per canon's one-primary-per-screen rule. (5) Transaction View content is placed in belowFold rather than as an on-screen module because only one ContextToggle mode is visible at a time — it is a mode swap, not additional scroll content, so it does not count against the 8-module cap for the default Budget View render.
